card.problem: Bid qualification, strategy, drafting, and review are split across tools and judgment.
card.user: A small B2G team deciding whether to pursue and how to own the response.
card.experience: A large verdict and four dimensions lead directly into Win Position selection.
card.mechanism: A decision ledger orders verdict, strategy, score map, blueprint, draft, review, and replay.
card.required_technology: Snowpark decides; Cortex Code writes one Snowflake run with every downstream artifact.
card.business_case: It replaces manual go or no-go and proposal kickoff with a replayable Bid Room.
card.build_scope: Responsive Seed Streamlit UI, authenticated Snowflake reads, policy, editor, and download.
card.proof_plan: Compare two suppliers, switch strategy, inspect the proposal, then reload the persisted run.

card.problem: Eligible bids still hide where points are won, which proof supports them, and what is missing.
card.user: A proposal lead allocating effort by official weight while binding proof and owners.
card.experience: A weighted score map shows readiness, asset, gap, and planned claim before drafting.
card.mechanism: The matrix drives Win Positions, criterion claims, proposal preview, review, and replay.
card.required_technology: Snowflake stores the graph and run; Snowpark decides and Cortex Code authors artifacts.
card.business_case: It directs writing effort before days are spent and retains reusable bid evidence.
card.build_scope: Responsive Seed application with three states, score map, proposal, review, and replay.
card.proof_plan: Show the 40-point row, switch supplier and position, rebuild, then replay the run.

card.problem: Proposal generators hide how intake became a decision and text, breaking replay and ownership.
card.user: A bid manager operating the pursuit as stages with every remaining action owned.
card.experience: Run identity and replay sit above six stages from Intake through Assign.
card.mechanism: Stages tie Win Position to score map, blueprint, draft, review, trace, and tasks.
card.required_technology: Snowflake is shared stage memory; Snowpark and Cortex Code write one versioned run.
card.business_case: It makes generation accountable, reduces handoff loss, and builds reusable memory.
card.build_scope: Responsive Seed Bid Room with six stages, persisted continuity, outputs, and tasks.
card.proof_plan: Open a run, trace execution, inspect stages and evidence, then replay after refresh.
